requiredFindings.title: Correct the inherited discovery census description’s obsolete held-out state
requiredFindings.detail: The inherited row for crates/security/src/custody/discovery_census.json says held-out entries outstanding. At the exact accepted product commit 72e078799b201709b2545ba58cdce3fcd62a933e, the blind run has populated all ten held-out entries as blind-census, and heldOutMargin is holds (blind census). This is an explicit state assertion contradicted by the integrated accepted artifact, rather than merely an incomplete description of newly added behavior. The successor currently preserves it unchanged under the assertion that inherited descriptions remain true.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Override this description to describe receipt-derived held-out rows and their freshness-dependent classification without asserting that they remain outstanding. Preserve the parent artifact and all unrelated inherited row values. Update the candidate pin, successor record’s inherited-row assessment/description-override accounting, and subject manifest to the corrected bytes, then resubmit. This needs no code change, test lane or blind run.
